message.content:
The “best” movie of 2020 is a matter of taste, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** (2019) as the standout film of that year—especially after its historic Oscar wins in 2020. It’s a masterful blend of dark comedy, thriller, and social commentary that resonated worldwide. If you’re looking for something else, you might also consider:

- **“Tenet”** – a mind‑bending sci‑fi thriller from Christopher Nolan.  
- **“Soul”** – an animated Pixar film that won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.  
- **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** – a powerful courtroom drama directed by Aaron Sorkin.

Each offers a unique experience, so pick one that matches your mood!
